USD.text: The US still shows decent growth with unemployment not showing signs of overheating for now. I suspect unemployment will be a figure to look at, as well as NVIDIA's earnings. Industrial Production has printed at -0.4% which was a big miss from consensus (0.1).

CHF.text: Current growth is slighty lower than expected and Inflation is below the 2% target meaning the SNB is unlikely to hike as much as other central banks during this inflationary period. The SNB is also looking to protect the 0.91 to 0.89 EUR/CHF level. If NVIDIAs numbers come out poor then we will likely see safe haven demand.
